boundary: This is a local backport of the user-confirmed Figma Book Detail master. It does not write Figma, alter the preserved page/component graph, create detached frames, change UiEvent/reducer/route/focus ownership, enter Motion Reference, or change any native client. The current Figma connector cannot expose an official current file revision after the live node reads, so no revision is fabricated.
